parts.text: Discover marine facilities and anchorages for Newport, Rhode Island at latitude 41.4901, longitude -71.3128. Search Radius: 10 NM. Trip type: overnight.

property.description: The response is a valid JSON object with a top-level 'facilities' array and no text outside the JSON block.
The agent calls 'FindPlacesNearby' (with the radius converted to meters) to discover facilities.
The agent calls a web search tool (e.g. batch_google_search) to find wild/natural anchorages that commercial POI databases miss.
Every entry in 'facilities' has numeric 'latitude' and 'longitude' values and a 'type'.
Facility entries carry the superset fields where available (e.g. 'website', 'business_status', 'is_wild', 'references').
